parameters.content:
## Mills | Lead magnets: all 11 services
**Webhook:** POST, form-urlencoded (what the site sends). The Respond nodes return JSON so the site sees a 200.
**Setup:**
1. Pick your Google Sheets and Gmail credentials on the three action nodes.
2. In the Sheet node choose your spreadsheet: a tab named "Leads" whose first-row headers match the column names (see the list in the Sheet node). Turn on Data > Create a filter, or use filter views, to sort by status, priority or service.
3. Activate, then copy the **Production URL** into js/lead-magnet.js (WEBHOOK_URL).
**Test:** use the Test URL once, then switch to Production.
